{{Quote|As part of her efforts to lessen infighting and streamline decision-making, Empress Acina has consolidated the Dark Council down from twelve seats to five.|[[Lana Beniko]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Sphere of Sith Doctrine''' was one of the five [[Spheres of Influence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] that was created by [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Darth Acina]] after the [[Eternal Empire conquest]]. The Sphere was the combination of the Spheres of [[Sphere of Ancient Knowledge|Ancient Knowledge]], [[Sphere of Mysteries|Mysteries]], and [[Sphere of Sith Philosophy|Sith Philosophy]] and was led by [[Dark Council]] member [[Darth Anathel]].<ref name="SOTG" />

==History==
The Sphere of Sith Doctrine was a power base of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] responsible for discovering and safeguarding Sith knowledge, and upholding the Sith Code. It was established by [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Darth Acina]] to lessen the infighting between [[Dark Council]] members, and was one of the five seats that succeeded the twelve [[Spheres of Influence]]. The Sphere was led by [[Darth Anathel]].

==Behind the scenes==
If the player character is [[Darth Nox]] (Occlus, Imperius) in the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']] expansion of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', the player may choose to kill Darth Anathel and assume his seat on the Dark Council as head of Sith Doctrine.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]''</ref>
